name: app-problem-and-solution-map-with-tick-ruler-and-central-circle
title: Problem and solution slide with tick ruler, two problem cards and a central solution card in a circle
whatItIs: A white slide with an outlined pill label, a headline with an italic serif phrase, a horizontal ruler of ticks, dashed connectors dropping to two grey Problem cards, and a central Solution card inside a huge thin circle that ends with a quote and CEO avatar.
whatItMeans: Structured and elegant; dashed lines and circle suggest a system converging on one answer.
techniques: Drop dashed connectors from a tick ruler to cards.
Place the solution card inside a giant thin circle.
Mark problems with red squares and solution with green.
End with a quote and small avatar.

vocabulary.definition: A line of small vertical ticks used as a decorative scale.
A small coloured square marking a category.
Elements arranged to lead to one central answer.
A quote with a small portrait and name.
